SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF((SELECT t.data FROM (SELECT CONCAT('Kumulasi: ',REPLACE(GROUP_CONCAT(j.nama SEPARATOR '|'),'|',' dan ')) AS data FROM perkara_kumulasi k JOIN jenis_perkara j ON j.id=k.jenis_perkara_id WHERE k.perkara_id=#perkara_id# HAVING COUNT(*)>0) t LIMIT 1),''),'\\b0') AS data
